title: Great experience visiting...
text: Great experience visiting small local cava places. Ivan was a great guide, very knowledgeable and fun to visit with.  Definitely a unique outing!
author: silverolihome

title: A true gem of a wine tour.
text: One of the best wine tours I have ever done. Small, personal and the cellars visited were outstanding. If you want a bespoke tour going to smaller independent wineries run by people who really care, all for a reasonable price, this is the tour. Highly recommended.

title: Cava!
text: A great experience despite the rain! Heaps of cava to taste :)

title: Cava and Kindness
text: This was a fabulous tour! I appreciated all the communication as the date drew closer, that they were able to accommodate my gluten allergy, and just the hospitality and knowledge I gained from each winery. It was truly a great experience that I can’t recommend enough. Ivan was a kind and gracious guide.

title: Excellent experience!
